svg.text: stm32-foc: sensorless FOC on Nucleo-F303RE + X-NUCLEO-IHM08M1
PWM / control ISR at PWM_FREQ = 20 kHz (3600-cycle budget, ~2300 used) · speed loop 1 kHz · units: electrical rad, rad/s
• 3-phase MOSFET bridge, L6398 gate drivers (LIN active-low)
• TIM1 centre-aligned PWM CH1-3 + CH1N-3N (PA8-10, PA7, PB0-1)
• TIM1 CC4 → triggers ADC1 injected sequence each period
• ADC1 JDR1-4: i_a, i_b, i_c, v_bus
• FPU (hard-float), CCM SRAM for the ISR call tree
• PC8 = ISR-time pin (scope) · USART2 → ST-Link VCP (COM5)
Rs 0.139 Ω, ψ 1.57 mWb, no HFI
CONTROL ISR (every PWM period) — ADC_IRQ_Fast_Dispatch → HAL_ADCEx_InjectedConvCpltCallback (Src/freertos.c)
foc-lib: FOC_Update() (Lib/foc-lib, platform-neutral, FOC_FAST_CODE in CCM)
Rs: DC ramp to CAL_CURRENT 5.25 A,
Lq: 1 kHz sine on q + d-axis hold
probe ok (salient) → RUNNING on HFI directly; probe fails → Align → I-f,
hfi_salient = false (HFI off for this run). Lock check: eSMO locked, speed agrees,
back-EMF plausible for FLUX_LINKAGE; else coast after LOCK_TIMEOUT.
CCR1-3, gate pins (AF ↔ GPIO off levels)
Coast = outputs_enabled false: six gate pins to GPIO
off levels (never clear MOE: it also stops the ADC trigger)
• Hardware over-current: break → MOE = 0, latched (AOE off)
• eSMO loses lock in RUNNING → coast
• HFI: tracker lost, wrong pole (reverse), unexplained
• Motoring only: speed PI clamped at iq ≥ 0, so the
bench supply never has to sink current
DEMO TASK (FreeRTOS defaultTask, 512 B stack, printf integers only) — StartDefaultTask
